title: 输出二叉树
summary: 按规定尺寸和居中规则把二叉树填入字符串矩阵，空位置使用空字符串。
insight: 树高为 h 时矩阵有 h 行、2^h-1 列；每个节点放在当前可用列区间中点，左右孩子递归使用两侧区间。
pitfalls: 每层节点的水平间隔由区间递归自然确定

solutions.title: 递归区间中点布局
solutions.idea: 先确定画布尺寸，再把每个节点放到其列区间中点。
steps: 创建 height×(2^height-1) 空字符串矩阵

code.java: class Solution { public List<List<String>> printTree(TreeNode root){int height=height(root),columns=(1<<height)-1;List<List<String>> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int row=0;row<height;row++)answer.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(columns,"")));fill(root,0,0,columns-1,answer);return answer;}private int height(TreeNode node){return node==null?0:1+Math.max(height(node.left),height(node.right));}private void fill(TreeNode node,int row,int left,int right,List<List<String>> answer){if(node==null)return;int middle=(left+right)/2;answer.get(row).set(middle,String.valueOf(node.val));fill(node.left,row+1,left,middle-1,answer);fill(node.right,row+1,middle+1,right,answer);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun printTree(root:TreeNode?):List<List<String>>{val height=height(root);val columns=(1 shl height)-1;val answer=MutableList(height){MutableList(columns){""}};fun fill(node:TreeNode?,row:Int,left:Int,right:Int){if(node==null)return;val middle=(left+right)/2;answer[row][middle]=node.`val`.toString();fill(node.left,row+1,left,middle-1);fill(node.right,row+1,middle+1,right)};fill(root,0,0,columns-1);return answer};private fun height(node:TreeNode?):Int=if(node==null)0 else 1+maxOf(height(node.left),height(node.right)) }
code.cpp: class Solution { int height(TreeNode* node){return node?1+max(height(node->left),height(node->right)):0;}void fill(TreeNode* node,int row,int left,int right,vector<vector<string>>& answer){if(!node)return;int middle=(left+right)/2;answer[row][middle]=to_string(node->val);fill(node->left,row+1,left,middle-1,answer);fill(node->right,row+1,middle+1,right,answer);}public:vector<vector<string>> printTree(TreeNode* root){int rows=height(root),columns=(1<<rows)-1;vector<vector<string>> answer(rows,vector<string>(columns));fill(root,0,0,columns-1,answer);return answer;} };
